name: in-flight-outranks-the-version
why: A door already submitted outranks the version comparison. Both targets are behind the proven release, but the pair has an open promote/v2.1.0 pull request, so it reads in-flight rather than pending: something is already moving, and opening a second door is not the next act. The door reference is carried through so a surface can name what it is waiting on rather than saying only that it waits.
